prompt_policy: First click is a deterministic GT-positive anchor. Later clicks are sampled uniformly from current false-negative/false-positive voxels and labelled from GT.
point_history: latest click only, matching SAM-Med3D default multi_click=False
mask_feedback: zero 32^3 low-resolution mask on click 1; previous decoder logits on later clicks
scoring: micro Dice over observed voxels in GT-positive oracle samples, plus mean/median per-sample Dice; this is interactive and not an automatic whole-survey result
threshold_policy: report fixed 0.5 and best micro-Dice threshold on validation; no test data accessed

normalization_details.r100_observed_zscore: existing R100 reader: statistics over raw nonzero observed voxels; invalid/padding kept zero
normalization_details.sam_positive_zscore: TorchIO-equivalent formula used by official SAM-Med3D: statistics over raw values > 0, then the affine z-score is applied to the entire zero-padded patch

crop_details.fixed_positive_grid: non-overlapping validation grid patches that contain observed fault labels
crop_details.label_centered: paired 128^3 crops centered on the exact same deterministic positive anchors; crops may overlap

limitations: Thebe provides a binary fault class, not fault-instance IDs; metrics therefore score the full fault class in each sample.
Label-centered crops, prompts, corrective clicks, and empty-patch exclusion use validation labels and are oracle-assisted.
These interactive results are not directly comparable with an automatic R100 whole-survey score.
